goal: SOTA BPC for autoregressive char-level text generation on enwik8 (target <= 1.05 BPC) and text8 (target <= 1.05 BPC).

committed_budget.source: LOCKED compute budget (2026-08-09) — HARD, final. The canonical kernel train.ipynb runs at EXACTLY this. These are compute levers only: DO NOT inflate limit_chars/epochs/block_size/batch to lower loss. INFLATING COMPUTE TO CUT BPC IS THE CHEAT WE ARE PREVENTING. Instead the agent must EXHAUST/EXPLOIT this budget: squeeze the LOWEST possible BPC WITHIN these fixed compute limits via architecture/efficiency work (tune the novel PerPos parts, data pipeline, schedule, regularization). The metric is minimum-BPC-under-budget and time-to-convergence-at-budget, never BPC-at-any-cost. Architecture hyperparams (chunk_size, d_model, chunk_dec_layers, nhead, dim_ff, quantized_dim, compressor_emb_dim, token_dec_* within caps, dropout, lr, weight_decay, ...) are tunable; budget fields are NOT. Steps/epoch auto-rescale to actual batch via steps_per_epoch_estimate().

architecture_caps.source: ANTI-GPT-IFICATION guardrail (2026-08-09). The token decoder is a SMALL upsampler by design; the chunk decoder is the main AR model. Inflating decoder layers/FF trivially lowers BPC by making the model a generic GPT transformer and UNDERMINES the novel PerPos hierarchy. These are HARD caps enforced in the kernel's coerce_config() - any config with over-cap values is clamped down and logged. The agent's earlier inflation (token_dec_layers 3>2, chunk FF 512->1024->2048) was this cheat; token decoder reset to canonical 2. Novel-architecture hyperparams (chunk_size, quantized_dim, compressor design, window warmup shape) remain freely tunable.

current_best.time_to_convergence: ~58.7 min (3524s) to 1.8833 BPC @ E40 at OLD LOCKED 30M/512/40ep/bs96 BUDGET (budget since recommitted to 10M/384). Note: this 1.8833 was recorded at the OLD budget and is NOT directly comparable to runs at the new locked budget; it is kept here as historical reference for the architecture.
current_best.notes: Iter-15 (kernel v23) = window-warmup run. New best 1.8833 BPC. Iter-17 (v25, chunk QK-norm rec 5) ERRORED at build time: QKNormAttention multiplied 4D logits [B*K,H,N,N] by 3D mask [B*K,N,N] (missing head-dim broadcast) — training never started (run kapdvdg0). Iter-18 (v26) fixes the mask broadcast (m->[B*K,1,N,N]) and re-runs the QK-norm architecture. Iter-19 (v27) recommits the compute budget to 10M chars / block 512 / stride 256 / bs384 (+ warmup 150, steps_per_execution 16, vectorized datasets, timing logs) — the first run at the new committed budget. Progression: 3.493 -> 3.268 -> 3.011 -> 2.5909 -> 2.3023 -> 2.2878 (d1024/40ep, bs256) -> 2.2597 (bs512@10M) -> 1.8869 (30M chars, bs512) -> 1.8833 (window-warmup, OLD budget) -> [1.9049 bigram regression] -> [v25 QK-norm build ERROR] -> 2.0549 (iter-19 v27, NEW locked budget, smaller sweep-arch).

locked_budget_baseline.note: NEW PRIMARY BASELINE as of 2026-08-10. BPC measured AT the locked committed_budget (10M/512/256/bs384). This supersedes current_best (which was at the old 30M/bs96 budget) as the in-budget comparison anchor for all future iterations. The agent's success metric is now: minimum BPC UNDER committed_budget + time-to-convergence.
locked_budget_baseline.time_to_convergence: ~14.75 min (885s total_fit) to 2.0549 BPC @ E40 at LOCKED 10M/512/256/bs384. Per-epoch ~10s steady + ~70s on every 8th epoch (sample logging triggers recompile). Wall-clock is ~4x FASTER than the old 30M/bs96 run, but BPC is +0.17 worse (smaller sweep-arch).
locked_budget_baseline.notes: Iter-19 (v27) was the FIRST run at the locked committed budget. The effective config (d_model 768, ff 1024, tokenL 1, qc 64, nhead 12) is a SWEEP-tuned SMALL arch that drifted below the canonical CONFIG in the committed notebook (which has d_model 1024, ff 2048, tokenL 2, qc 128, nhead 8). PRIMARY GOAL: EXHAUST THE BUDGET. Find the lowest BPC achievable at the locked 10M/512/256/bs384 budget. Every iteration must either improve BPC under this budget or justify the config on time-to-convergence — NEVER escape the budget by inflating compute. In-budget comparison anchor is now locked_budget_baseline (iter-19: 2.0549 BPC @ 14.75min).

Architecture tuning is OPEN within caps (token_dec_layers<=2, token_dec_dim_ff<=256, chunk_dec_layers<=8, chunk_dec_dim_ff<=2048): tune chunk_size, d_model, nhead, quantized_dim, compressor_emb_dim, window-warmup shape, lr, weight_decay. These are the real BPC levers under the fixed budget.

After v28 lands: if canonical arch beats 2.0549 BPC under locked budget, set it as the new in-budget baseline and re-enable the online W&B sweep over architecture params (d_model/chunk_dec_layers/chunk_size/lr/quantized_dim/compressor_emb_dim) seeded from the winning config. Sweep space MUST be locked to bs384 + caps enforced.
